input: Sort through and donate old kids' clothing by size

gold.taskTitle: Sort and Donate Old Kids Clothing by Size
gold.taskDescription: Sort through children's clothing, organize by size, and donate items that are no longer needed.

questions.title: How many children's clothing sizes are involved?
questions.description: Understanding the range of sizes (e.g., newborn through 10T) helps estimate the scope of the sorting job.

questions.title: Where is all the clothing currently stored?
questions.description: Knowing whether clothes are in one place or spread across closets, bins, attic, or garage determines how much gathering is needed first.

questions.title: Are you keeping any sizes for a younger sibling?
questions.description: Clarifies whether certain size ranges should be set aside rather than donated, affecting how items get sorted.

questions.title: Do you have a specific donation destination in mind?
questions.description: Identifies whether the user has a preferred charity, consignment shop, or community group to donate to.

questions.title: Should items be checked for stains or damage before donating?
questions.description: Determines if a quality-check step needs to be built into the sorting process.

questions.title: What is your deadline for completing this task?
questions.description: Establishes whether this is urgent (e.g., ahead of a move or new baby) or a flexible weekend project.

questions.title: How do you want sorted clothes physically organized?
questions.description: Clarifies the preferred method, such as labeled bags per size, boxes, or bundled by type within each size group.
